title: In-game Trainer 0.4.0-beta.2 — Halloween currencies and input fixes
body:
## Changes

- Add Haunted candles and Halloween feathers, pumpkins and skulls under F2 → Resources. Enter the desired total and Apply in the saloon; ingredients already deposited in the cauldron are preserved.
- Fix F2 reopening the last F4 Joker page. F2 now returns to the last normal trainer category.
- Establish UI input even when the cursor is already visible; restore gameplay input when no native menu was open.

Download **FFWTrainer-0.4.0-beta.2.zip**, extract it and copy the contents of GameRoot into the game folder. Fully restart the game. Keep Data/settings.json when updating. Source and SHA-256 checksums are separate assets.

## 中文

新增幽灵蜡烛、万圣节羽毛、南瓜和骷髅，在 F2 → 资源中输入目标总量并应用，保留坩埚已投入材料。修复 F2/F4 串页，并补齐光标已显示时的输入模式与关闭恢复。

安装时复制 GameRoot 内容并完整重启游戏；更新保留 Data/settings.json。安装包不含个人数据、存档、日志或临时采样脚本。

## Validation

All 30 standalone Lua test files passed. Currency keys were read from live game data; archive contents and hashes were checked. New currency save/reload and the reporter's exact mouse issue still need live acceptance. This is a prerelease; no real currency grant was performed during development.
